en: A black‑and‑white photograph of an ornate, Neo‑Renaissance style building with two corner towers, a central flag, and long arcaded wings opening onto a formal garden. Manicured conical shrubs, flower beds, and paths lead toward the building, with benches and several people visible in the foreground. On the right side stands a signpost with text, suggesting a spa or resort facility. The whole composition has the formal, front‑on style typical of early 20th‑century postcards.
